item.title: EA-18G Growlers Carrying Mixed Load Of Old And New Jamming Pods Are Flying Iran Missions
item.description: A Pentagon report says the new pods are still having significant teething issues even though they are being used in active conflicts. The post EA-18G Growlers Carrying Mixed Load Of Old And New Jamming Pods Are Flying Iran Missions appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Allies Push Back On Trump’s Demand They Send Warships To Strait Of Hormuz (Updated)
item.description: Germany on Monday flatly rejected Trump's demand that NATO allies send naval vessels to help protect shipping in this strategic waterway. The post Allies Push Back On Trump’s Demand They Send Warships To Strait Of Hormuz (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Japan’s EC-2 Electronic Warfare Jet, Arguably The World’s Ugliest Aircraft, Just Flew For The First Time
item.description: In a world of increasingly homogeneous-looking military aircraft designs, the platypus-like Kawasaki EC-2 is a radical outlier. The post Japan’s EC-2 Electronic Warfare Jet, Arguably The World’s Ugliest Aircraft, Just Flew For The First Time appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Navy E-2D Hawkeyes Appear To Be Rushing To The Middle East
item.description: The E-2D is America's most capable platform for spotting drones and other low-flying Iranian threats that are wreaking havoc on Gulf Arab States. The post Navy E-2D Hawkeyes Appear To Be Rushing To The Middle East appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Trump No Longer Wants Allies To Send Warships To Open The Strait Of Hormuz (Updated)

item.title: Navy Juggles Its Aircraft Carrier Plans To Stay Afloat (Updated)
item.description: One carrier was already tired before it had a fire, another saw its service life extended for the second time, while the delivery of a third is delayed. The post Navy Juggles Its Aircraft Carrier Plans To Stay Afloat (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: U.S. Navy Minesweepers Stationed In Middle East Are Now In Singapore

item.title: Iran’s Energy Infrastructure Is Now On The Targeting List (Updated)
